title: Parameter contract notary and user-facing error guidelines
creator: Aisha Patel
description: We need a single, opinionated guideline and lightweight "notary" layer for tool/function parameter contracts that: 1) defines the JSON shape authors should publish, 2) prescribes validation behavior in runtime (streaming and non-streaming), and 3) standardizes user-facing error messages and recovery hints. This ticket captures the design decisions, example DSL/manifest, error taxonomy, and recommended runtime actions (reject vs best-effort vs coerce). The goal is to reduce ambiguous errors, improve developer UX, and make telemetry actionable for regressions and compatibility checks.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A one-page spec (doc) that defines the published contract JSON format (compact, human-friendly) and migration rules for v1->v2
A2: Error taxonomy with canonical codes and example messages for the top 12 common failure modes
A3: A runtime validation decision matrix describing behavior for: missing required field, type mismatch, extra fields, partial stream segments, truncated JSON, and KV-cache streaming context
A4: Example authoring templates for 3 common cases: simple search tool (flat params), database upsert (nested objects), and async job kick-off (idempotency + callback URL), plus sample error messages
A5: A developer-facing guideline page linked from the SDK docs and a PR template for tool onboarding that includes contract linting checks
tasks: T1: Draft compact contract schema grammar (YAML + JSON examples) and publish to docs (confluence link placeholder)
T2: Define canonical error codes (ERR_INV_MISSING, ERR_INV_TYPE, ERR_INV_EXTRA, ERR_INV_STREAM_TRUNC, ERR_INV_COERCED) and standard message templates
T3: Design validation matrix for streaming vs non-streaming paths and integrate into runtime decision tree
T4: Add telemetry tags for contract violations (contract_id, field_path, error_code, request_mode) and a sample alert query
T5: Implement a lightweight 'notary' library used at onboarding that verifies published contract JSON and emits warnings/errs
T6: Create example tool manifests and run against the lint harness; capture false positives and tune rules
comments: 2025-02-15 - Aisha Patel: Initial stub created after spikes on streaming validation. Linking notes from spike: https://confluence.internal/redwood/tool-contract-spike-2025-02

2025-02-18 - Marco Liu: Investigated current runtime behavior: streaming partial JSONs often cause JSON::ParserError in worker side; observed 3p tools return extra debug fields that break strict validation. Suggest three validation modes: strict, permissive-coerce, permissive-ignore.

2025-02-21 - Design review (Jules Moreno): UX preference is to surface concise actionable messages and a single remediation hint; avoid exposing raw schema in user errors. We should map error_code -> friendly_message + remediation_link.
2025-02-25 - Security (Rina Gupta): KMS/HSM and callback URLs need explicit validation rules to avoid SSRF. Add validator for allowed-schemes and hostname allowlist for private deployments.

2025-02-27 - Marco Liu: Drafted canonical error set and sample messages. Example: ERR_INV_MISSING -> 'Parameter \"items\" is required for tool:order-create. See docs: /tool-contracts#order-create'. Added suggestion: caller can provide a minimal fallback payload to proceed.

2025-03-01 - Aisha Patel: Telemetry plan added. Proposed event: contract_violation.logged with tags: contract_id, severity, error_code, field_path, is_streaming, request_id. Sample alert: rate of ERR_INV_TYPE > 0.5% over 1h -> paging to oncall.

2025-03-03 - Marco Liu: Implemented prototype notary CLI that verifies contract files and emits a pass/warn/fail exit code. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7421 (draft). Need maintainers' review before merging.

2025-03-05 - QA (Lina Torres): Ran the lint harness against 12 internal tool manifests. Found 4 cases where arrays of objects lacked explicit item schemas; recommend default behavior: accept arrays if items are scalars, otherwise require explicit item schema and raise ERR_INV_AMBIGUOUS if omitted.
2025-03-05 - Marco Liu: Marking In Progress. Next: finalize messages, add streaming partial JSON heuristics, and schedule security review.
